caseNameFull: Melissa Kay COOK v. Cynthia Ann HARDING

opinions.text: Motion of Concerned United Birthparents, Inc., et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of American Association of Pro-Life Obstetricians & Gynecologists, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of 10 Feminist Academics and Advocates for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
